name: @semicoder/fia
description: Build macOS applications with a precompiled native host, Bun and WebView

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/index.js && bun build src/config.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/config.js && bun build src/client.ts --target=browser --outfile=dist/client.js && bun build src/backend.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/backend.js && bun build src/vite.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist/vite.js && bun ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test tests
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun -e 'await import("./src/artifacts.ts").then(m => m.verifyAssets())'
